records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total net sales increased approximately 24% and 39% for the thirteen and twenty-six weeks ended July 31, 2021 as compared to the thirteen and twenty-six weeks ended August 1, 2020 driven largely by increased store foot traffic relative to last year which was impacted by widespread temporary store closures due to COVID-19.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In light of store closures related to COVID-19, the Company has not disclosed comparable sales for Fiscal 2020 or Fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: There have been no material changes during the thirteen weeks ended July 31, 2021 in the contractual obligations as of January 30, 2021, with the exception of those obligations which occurred in the normal course of business (primarily changes in the Company’s merchandise inventory-related purchases and lease obligations, which fluctuate throughout the year as a result of the seasonal nature of the Company’s operations).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter of Fiscal 2021, stores and distribution expense increased 5% as compared to the second quarter of Fiscal 2020, primarily driven by a $22 million increase in store payroll expense, reflecting the return of certain expenses saved last year from COVID-19 temporary store closures and an $8 million increase in digital sales marketing expense.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company relies on excess operating cash flows, which are largely generated in Fall, to fund operations throughout the year and to reinvest in the business to support future growth.
